title: Backend API
description: The FastAPI process: HTTP traffic, scheduler jobs, DB pool, CPU and memory.

panels.title: p95
panels.description: 95th percentile request time over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Routes in range
panels.description: Busiest routes in the time range, with their 5xx count and p95 latency. route=unmatched is everything that hit no route (404s, retired /v1 /v2).

panels.title: Errors, skipped and missed runs in range
panels.description: skipped: a run was due while the previous one was still going (max_instances). missed: the scheduler woke up too late.

panels.title: SQLAlchemy pool
panels.description: Connections the backend holds from its pool. Checked out reaching the limit means requests queue for a connection.
